mutations.name: an edit run's skip reads as the earlier run's success
mutations.replace: return runs.map((run) => (run.workflowRunId !== null && edits.has(run.workflowRunId) && ranBefore(run) ? { ...run, conclusion: "success" } : run));
kills: merge facts after a no-op edit fix-proof run stays red when the real run's mutants job failed before the edit run skipped it

mutations.name: a run that skipped only some fix-proof jobs counts as an edit run
mutations.find: new Set(jobs.map((run) => run.name)).size === FIX_PROOF_JOBS.size && jobs.every((run) => run.conclusion === "skipped")
kills: merge facts after a no-op edit fix-proof run keeps a later run's skips when that run did not skip every fix-proof job

mutations.name: merge facts read the newest run per name without dropping edit-run skips
